question: On which date has ‘National Space Day’ been declared in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**23 अगस्त**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India celebrates **National Space Day** on **23 August** every year to commemorate the successful landing of the **Chandrayaan-3** mission.
 
• On **23 August 2023**, the **Vikram lander** of the **Chandrayaan-3** mission successfully touched down on the **Lunar South Pole**.
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** made the official announcement of this day during his visit to the **ISRO Telemetry Tracking and Command Network (ISTRAC)** in **Bengaluru** on **August 26, 2023**.
 
• With this achievement, India became the **fourth** country in the world to land a spacecraft on the **Moon** and the **first** ever to land near the **Southern Polar region** of the lunar surface.
 
• The landing site of the **Chandrayaan-3** lander was named **'Shiv Shakti Point'**, symbolizing the connection between humanity and the celestial bodies. ***Hence, the correct option is 23 अगस्त.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **11 मई (11 May):**

 
 
• This date is celebrated as **National Technology Day** in India.
 
• It marks the anniversary of the **Pokhran-II** nuclear tests conducted in **1998** under the leadership of then Prime Minister **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**.
 
• It highlights the achievements of **Indian scientists** and engineers in the field of **science and technology**.
 
 
 
• **20 जुलाई (20 July):**
 
 
• This date is recognized globally as **International Moon Day**.
 
• It commemorates the anniversary of the first human landing on the **Moon** by the **Apollo 11** mission in **1969**, where **Neil Armstrong** and **Buzz Aldrin** walked on the lunar surface.
 
 
 
• **28 फरवरी (28 February):**
 
 
• This date is celebrated as **National Science Day** in India.
 
• It commemorates the discovery of the **'Raman Effect'** by the renowned Indian physicist **Sir C.V. Raman** on **28 February 1928**.
 
• For this discovery, **Sir C.V. Raman** was awarded the **Nobel Prize in Physics** in **1930**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Chandrayaan-3 Mission Details:**

 
 
• The mission was launched on **14 July 2023** using the **LVM3-M4** rocket from the **Satish Dhawan Space Centre** in **Sriharikota**.
 
• The mission components included a **Propulsion Module**, the **Vikram Lander**, and the **Pragyan Rover**.
 
• The **rover** performed various experiments on the lunar surface to study the **chemical composition** and **mineralogy** of the **South Pole**.
 
 
 
• **Naming of Lunar Sites:**
 
 
• Apart from **Shiv Shakti Point**, the Prime Minister also named the spot where **Chandrayaan-2** left its hard-landing footprints in **2019** as **'Tiranga Point'**.
 
 
 
• **Theme of First National Space Day:**
 
 
• The theme for the maiden **National Space Day** celebrated in **2024** was **"Touching Lives while Touching the Moon: India's Space Saga"**.
 
• The **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** was founded on **15 August 1969** and is currently headquartered in **Bengaluru**, **Karnataka**.
